function: Downlink channel estimation for FDD near-field XL-MIMO: CenterNet locates user and scatterers in uplink channel images, OMP refines, least squares gives gains (p. 3).
system: Single-cell FDD XL-MIMO, BS ULA with N=1,024 antennas, single-antenna UE, no RIS, carrier 6.7 GHz in the upper 6 GHz band (p. 4).
method: Supervised CenterNet object detector (ResNet-50 backbone, three-stage decoder, three heads) on Cartesian-domain channel images, followed by OMP refinement and least squares (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Self-generated multi-cluster near-field channel images, said to follow 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi cluster structure; 10,000 train, 2,000 validation, 2,000 test, SNR 0-20 dB (p. 4).
test_conditions: Train and test images from the same simulated model, SNR 0-20 dB, L and S in {2,3,5}; claims generalization to varied L/S and user positions without retraining (p. 5).
baselines: Learned: near-field CKNet [10]. Non-learned: SIGW [9] and cascaded OMP. Also own ALL PATH pilot variant, and complexity comparison with YOLOv7, MRDN, GAN-CBD (pp. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE of the reconstructed downlink channel versus SNR for varying L and S; computational complexity (orders, parameters, GFLOPs); number of downlink pilots (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Table I orders: about 10^9 for cascaded OMP versus 10^8 proposed; CenterNet about 32M parameters and 35 GFLOPs, versus YOLOv7 about 105 GFLOPs (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel follows the 5G NR channel specifications defined in the 3GPP TR 38.901 standard, referring to the scattering cluster structure in the urban microcell (UMi) scenario"
q2_support: p. 5: "it generalizes well across randomly generated user positions and varied L/S parameter settings without requiring retraining". Missing: no statement that any tested L/S value or scenario was absent from training; p. 4 describes one dataset, SNR 0-20 dB, L and S in 2, 3, or 5.
q3_support: p. 5: "We compare the performance of the proposed CenterNet-based downlink channel estimation scheme with the near-field CKNet-based method, the SIGW-based method, and the cascaded OMP-based approach". Fig. 5 legend: CKNet[10], SIGW[9]; metric NMSE.
q5_support: p. 4: "we generate 10000, 2000, and 2000 channel images in the Cartesian domain under different SNR scenarios (0 ∼ 20 dB) as training, validation, and testing datasets". Self-generated data; no link, DOI, or code release anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 2: the learned detector serves downlink channel estimation (NMSE is the main metric); localization of user and scatterers is an intermediate step. q1 is borderline: the channel is a custom near-field multi-cluster model (Eq. 1-3, p. 2) and TR 38.901 UMi is cited only for the cluster structure (p. 4); marked 1 because the paper states the channel follows TR 38.901, reviewer to confirm. q2 is 0 because the paper claims generalization over L/S without retraining (p. 5) but never states the L/S composition of the training set; Fig. 4(c) shows S=4, outside the S in {2,3,5} listed on p. 4, without comment. q3: CKNet is cited as [10] only in the Fig. 5 legend (an earlier keypoint-detection paper by the same authors); its learned nature is inferred from the name and from the description of [10] on p. 1.
